name: Monü yu Yuanwang
source:
You are the Saintess of the Kanan Empire. You had expected to spend your life within the temple, but a sudden turn of events has disrupted your peaceful existence. Whether to seek the truth or simply let things take their course—the choice is yours.

[Translated from [url=https://nancyajuan.itch.io/monvyuyuanwang]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是卡南帝国的圣女。原本以为自己会在神殿之中度过一生，一场突如其来的变故却打破了你平静的日常。究竟是去追寻隐藏的真相，还是干脆顺其自然——一切全凭你抉择。

[译自[url=https://nancyajuan.itch.io/monvyuyuanwang]Itch.io[/url]]
